header: Chip: QTI SM8350 (Snapdragon 888) · 7.7 GB RAM · context 4096
CPU features: fp asimd evtstrm aes pmull sha1 sha2 crc32 atomics fphp asimdhp cpuid asimdrdm lrcpc dcpop asimddp
GPU:  · setting: CPU · 3 threads · heat thresholds: moderate at 0.9333333373069763
context_rule: r27: n_ctx 4096 at every kit load (Research.nCtx), not the app's free-RAM rule
touch_rule: factor touch (c1-olmoe 0012): on = {VOLLIE_TOUCH: 1, VOLLIE_TOUCH_S: 12}; llama_vollie_touch_begin(the hold's wanted set) right after exec_sync, before the gate wait (row touch_begin); llama_vollie_touch_end() after the hold, before smaps_before (row touch_end: the last pass, which blocks until done); c2-touch lines per pass; called in every gated run (rc -1 = knob unset, nothing done)
nice_rule: factor nice (c1-olmoe 0012): on = {VOLLIE_NICE: -10}; every pool thread (the caller included) at each graph start, set once when it differs; off restores the old value by tid; c2-nice line per prompt
pin_rule: factor pin (c1-olmoe 0010): on = {VOLLIE_POOL: 1, VOLLIE_CPUMASK: 0xf0} (persistent pool, poll 0; every thread sets its affinity to the mask at each graph start when it differs); off = no VOLLIE_POOL: a new worker pair per graph that inherits the calling Dart thread's mask; the app's DartWorker pin in both; c2-pool line per prompt
exec_rule: factor exec (c1-olmoe 0011): on = {VOLLIE_EXEC_MAP: 1}; applied by llama_vollie_exec_sync() right after the run's env is set, before its gate wait (row exec_sync; the runtime's c2-exec line shows want, errno, the /proc/self/maps protection); off = PROT_READ; void when storage.exec_factor is not "live"

design.rule: r28: pin + exec in every run; claim blocks = claim_runs runs of one configuration; quad blocks = 4 quads, quad k (0..3) of a model takes row (k + 2 x model index) % 4; two warm-ups per block (no gate)

instrument_changes: static dark kit screen while the kit runs (no spinner; memo-28 §2.2)
no OpenCL backend or OpenCL helper in the APK (memo-28 §2.5)
VOLLIE_SCHED=1 in every run: per-thread schedstat / context switches per graph in the runtime (T1)
res_after from the run-end page vector (one mincore less; its ms is now the count from the vector, memo-28 §3.2)
no vmstat / /proc/self/io reads inside the timed window (vmstat_first, io_read_bytes_to_first_chunk gone; both were unreadable)
native library hashes once per session (libs per load row unchanged in meaning)
native env strings freed; the log read from the last offset (memo-28 §3.5, 3.6, 3.8, 3.9)
T1 records: ru (getrusage start / first chunk / end), smaps_before / smaps_after
T3: the second profiled run per block in block mode (id _profb)
r28: no profiled runs; pin + exec in every run (factors are touch and nice)
r28 (T-D): smaps matches the model mapping by inode as well as path (smaps_*.inode)

r28 (T-B): power (power saving, low_power, thermal status, battery %) before every run; workers_after (DartWorker threads: tid, nice, priority, policy, cpu, cgroup) after every run; proc_before / proc_after (/proc/stat cpu rows and /proc/loadavg, or their errno) around every run
r28: session label (deep-sleeping list) and power-save state at the start and the end
owner_note: Before you start: close background apps and unplug the charger. The kit pauses while a charger is connected.

baseline_note: arm off = r22 knob-off arm (campaign 1 shipping settings minus numerics, repack on, GGML_C2_IO=1), loaded with the model's load env (OLMoE VOLLIE_HEAD2_REPACK=1: head in CPU_REPACK, R61); arm num = off + the model's num env (declared numerics, R59/R61); GGML_PREFILL_COLD and GGML_KEEP_WARM are never set; hold = app-side read-back of the pages the gate wait took (memo-22 §2, r23 rule unchanged), no env, in every gated run; r26: gate rule r16 in every gated run (no plateau factor); 3 threads in every run; the kit pauses while a charger is connected (charger_rule); one arm per model (arm_rule); r27: kv clear in every run, factors pin and exec (pin_rule, exec_rule, design)
arm_rule: r28: the arm per block (design.blocks): Granite num in its blocks; OLMoE off in its claim and quad blocks and num (MASS=900 + head 1024, R61 host 12.0927 / 12.0976 against the budget 12.3003) in its last claim block; OLMoE keeps its load env (VOLLIE_HEAD2_REPACK=1)
kv_rule: r27: VOLLIE_KV_DONTNEED=1 in every run (R66). Before: scored runs alternate VOLLIE_KV_DONTNEED=1 (spec kv, id suffix _kv; c1-olmoe 0008, declared bit-identical): llama_memory_clear(data) releases the KV / recurrent buffers' page-aligned interior with MADV_DONTNEED instead of a memset; one c2-kvclear line per buffer (kind kv / rs, bytes, released, why, us, tag); r26: c1-olmoe 0009 computes the range on the untagged address (tag = its top byte); two ABBA quads per block, on off off on / off on on off in odd blocks, the reverse in even ones; warm-ups and profiled runs off

hold_rule.advice: posix_fadvise WILLNEED on the pages resident at the previous run end of the model and not now; one pass in the wait at >= every_ms, then passes every settle_ms after the gate until back, stall, rounds or max_ms

thread_rule.note: llama.cpp threads = the spec's threads (prompt and decode); the app restricts its DartWorker threads (and the ggml workers they start) to pinned_cpus as a set at each generation; r27: pin runs also set the mask in the runtime at every graph start (pin_rule)

gate.rule: r16 per spec (gate_rule; r26: every gated run)

plateau.test: min(last window readings) >= min(the window before them) - eps and max(readings of this wait) - min(last window readings) >= fall, at >= from_ms

charger_rule: at every gate poll: plugged -> pause (poll every 5 s) until unplugged, then the wait starts again (row plug_pauses); plugged_run = plugged before or after the run
